canonical_definition: Image captioning is the task of generating textual descriptions from visual inputs such as images or videos, requiring cross-modal understanding between vision and language. It often serves as a benchmark for evaluating multimodal understanding/generation, visual perception and cognition, and alignment capabilities in vision-language models, with variants including contextual captioning, zero-shot approaches, and object/region-level descriptions that demand varying degrees of logical reasoning and common sense understanding.
